plan.notes:
SEMESTER CREDITS: all credit values are semester credit hours as stated in the catalog's "Sem. Credit Hours" course-table column, transcribed verbatim.
Source: official ATA College (El Cajon, CA) 2021 Catalog (BPPE 2021 Annual Report filing); newest official catalog located (atacollege.edu checked 2026-09-30).
Certificate program: 3 weeks of instruction, 20 hours/week; 60 clock hours. The catalog publishes a single 3-week block with no module subdivision, so the full course list forms one semester. Successful completion leads to credit towards the Medical Assistant AAS degree and eligibility for the national EKG certification exam.
CREDIT HONESTY: total_credits is the exact sum of the transcribed per-course values (3.31), matching the catalog's printed "PROGRAM TOTALS 60 3.31".
